likeness_notes.relative_height: Zuv remains exactly two inches taller; equal camera depth and equal head scale are mandatory in the slide-9 proof.
likeness_notes.attempt_01_failure: The quarantined attempt-01 proof was not approved: Aachu and Zuv both read too narrow/elongated, Zuv had excessive forward curl mass, and the height gap was exaggerated.
likeness_notes.attempt_02_failure: The quarantined attempt-02 proof was not approved: Zuv presented the wrong anatomical hand, an extra forearm remained visible, Aachu and Zuv still drifted narrow/elongated, and the head-scale/height gap was exaggerated.
likeness_notes.attempt_03_failure: The quarantined attempt-03 proof failed the independent pixel review: Zuv again presented his anatomical left hand instead of his right, an unexplained lower limb edge remained, the crop exposed Aachu’s waist and pockets, both likenesses drifted, and the scale gap remained too large.
likeness_notes.creator_override: The creator explicitly accepted the exact attempt-03 pixels bound to image-set SHA-256 7627e7fa8fae69d8176861839cc0b87a583f3857d1d08010d96c54017b37e32c with the known QA exceptions preserved.
